```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource/maple-mono@5.2.5/index.min.css">

<style>
.lnk-outer {
  width: 100%;
  margin: 1em 0;
  border: 1.5px solid #5654A2;
  border-radius: 14px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.lnk-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 28% 1fr;
  border-top: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
  background: #F8F7F0;
}
.lnk-row:first-child { border-top: none; }
.lnk-label {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 0.85em;
  border-right: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
}
.lnk-chips {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 10px 16px;
  align-items: center;
}
.lnk-btn {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 5px 14px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  border: 1.5px solid;
  font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 0.82em;
  text-decoration: none;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease;
}

/* Purple — Research */
.lnk-purple .lnk-label { color: #5654A2; background: #EEEDF8; }
.lnk-purple .lnk-btn   { border-color: #5654A2; color: #5654A2; background: #EEEDF8; }
.lnk-purple .lnk-btn:hover { background: #5654A2; color: #F8F7F0; text-decoration: none; }

/* Blue — Coding */
.lnk-blue .lnk-label { color: #2471A3; background: #EBF5FB; }
.lnk-blue .lnk-btn   { border-color: #2471A3; color: #2471A3; background: #EBF5FB; }
.lnk-blue .lnk-btn:hover { background: #2471A3; color: #F8F7F0; text-decoration: none; }

/* Green — Note Taking */
.lnk-green .lnk-label { color: #1E8449; background: #E9F7EF; }
.lnk-green .lnk-btn   { border-color: #1E8449; color: #1E8449; background: #E9F7EF; }
.lnk-green .lnk-btn:hover { background: #1E8449; color: #F8F7F0; text-decoration: none; }

/* Orange — Related Blog */
.lnk-orange .lnk-label { color: #CA6F1E; background: #FEF5E7; }
.lnk-orange .lnk-btn   { border-color: #CA6F1E; color: #CA6F1E; background: #FEF5E7; }
.lnk-orange .lnk-btn:hover { background: #CA6F1E; color: #F8F7F0; text-decoration: none; }

@media (max-width: 520px) {
  .lnk-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .lnk-label {
    border-right: none;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
    padding: 8px 14px;
  }
  .lnk-chips { padding: 10px 14px; }
}
</style>

<div class="lnk-outer">
  <div class="lnk-row lnk-purple">
    <div class="lnk-label">Research</div>
    <div class="lnk-chips">
      <a href="https://scholar.google.com" class="lnk-btn" target="_blank">Google Scholar</a>
      <a href="https://library.gwu.edu" class="lnk-btn" target="_blank">GWU Library</a>
      <a href="https://www.connectedpapers.com" class="lnk-btn" target="_blank">Connected Papers</a>
      <a href="https://www.zotero.org" class="lnk-btn" target="_blank">Zotero</a>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="lnk-row lnk-blue">
    <div class="lnk-label">Coding</div>
    <div class="lnk-chips">
      <a href="https://github.com" class="lnk-btn" target="_blank">GitHub</a>
      <a href="https://desktop.github.com" class="lnk-btn" target="_blank">GitHub Desktop</a>
      <a href="https://posit.co" class="lnk-btn" target="_blank">RStudio</a>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="lnk-row lnk-green">
    <div class="lnk-label">Note Taking</div>
    <div class="lnk-chips">
      <a href="https://quarto.org" class="lnk-btn" target="_blank">Quarto</a>
      <a href="https://www.craft.do" class="lnk-btn" target="_blank">Craft Doc</a>
      <a href="https://www.notion.so" class="lnk-btn" target="_blank">Notion</a>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="lnk-row lnk-orange">
    <div class="lnk-label">Related Blog</div>
    <div class="lnk-chips">
      <a href="https://pingfanhu.com/blog/2023-12-09-personal-website/" class="lnk-btn" target="_blank">How to Make a Personal Website</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```
